unit: Read QA Marker / Assert QA Marker
description: Before any write the harness reads QA_MARKER!A2 from the target spreadsheet and refuses unless it is exactly QA_ONLY_DO_NOT_WRITE_PRODUCTION.
why_it_exists: An id check alone only proves the id is not the one production id you thought of. The marker proves positively that the target sheet is a sheet somebody deliberately built for QA - the production register has no QA_MARKER tab, so a mis-pointed harness fails closed rather than writing synthetic matters into a live register.

expect.error: QA PREFLIGHT: marker mismatch at QA_MARKER!A2. Got: "". Stopping before any write.

assertions: A missing tab, a missing cell and a wrong string all produce the same refusal - absence is never treated as permission.
The comparison is exact string equality against QA_ONLY_DO_NOT_WRITE_PRODUCTION.
The id-collision check is repeated inside the marker assertion, so neither gate alone is a single point of failure.
qa_ok is only set true when both the marker matched and the ids differ.
target_unresolved_reason: QA-harness-only nodes (Read QA Marker / Assert QA Marker). No production unit.
